body:
The unchanged B570 overnight prompt now has a completed finite NIGHT experiment and a subsequent normative audit. The original prefill repair preserves B570's own reference on all 24 shared MBPP tasks, but fails on MBPP/72 in the eight-task unused cohort. C and the original-anchor resident checks pass in their fixed scopes; E rejects every new repaired UB2 candidate on reference qualification.

- Completed all **1,456 core requests**, engineering controls and the **144-request efficiency pilot**. Scientific failures and all attempts are retained; inputs, references and performance samples were not replaced.
- Shared-cohort repaired/ordinary-native speed ratios are **0.9995x generation / 1.2471x whole request**. Against matched target they are **0.8040x / 0.6935x**; against ordinary reference **0.1885x / 0.1791x**. The report bounds the qualified C subset gains by task, cap and configuration.
- E remains **NO_GO_PILOT**: all five repaired UB2 candidates fail on old diagnostic tasks /42, /145 and /138. Failed-output timings are diagnostic; no independently qualified replacement or broad deployment gain is claimed.
- Original independent CPU validation passes **363,698 checks on 1,961 records**. A separate normative auditor passes **64,921 checks**, recomputes all **744 cost rows**, and rechecks the original archive/restoration and **153 asset hashes**.
- The audit found the mechanism selector had covered only C failures. A timestamped, source-frozen supplement completes the first two failed E task/configuration pairs in the fixed ordering: /42 and /145, k1/UB2, cap128. It adds **8 old-profile bridge requests + 10 natural parents + 14 excluded warmups**, with **zero new performance samples**. Independent verification passes **21,172 checks on 4,108 full decision-logit rows**. The original failures persist; current causal status remains **NOT_CAUSALLY_IDENTIFIED**.
- Explicit frontend synchronization-call counts are now separately derived from frozen source and actual request branches. Internal runtime synchronization and kernel-dispatch counts remain unavailable.
- Both immutable local evidence packages restore successfully. Final fresh GitHub fetch/checkout verifies **all 210 study files** at `66594b349955e66146702325559c26019ea16485`. Combined evidence is **1,993 records**, including the separate audit supplement. Status: **COMPLETE_FINITE_SCOPE_AUDITED**.

[中文实验报告](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/66594b349955e66146702325559c26019ea16485/benchmarks/b570_closeout_overnight_v1/REPORT.md) · [规范性审核与补齐报告](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/66594b349955e66146702325559c26019ea16485/benchmarks/b570_closeout_overnight_v1/normative_audit_20261007/REVIEW_REPORT.md) · [决定与范围](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/66594b349955e66146702325559c26019ea16485/benchmarks/b570_closeout_overnight_v1/DECISION.json) · [原阶段计数](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/66594b349955e66146702325559c26019ea16485/benchmarks/b570_closeout_overnight_v1/STAGE_COUNTS.json) · [审核决定](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/66594b349955e66146702325559c26019ea16485/benchmarks/b570_closeout_overnight_v1/normative_audit_20261007/AUDIT_DECISION.json)

Prompt v1, the manuscript and historical studies are preserved. The original numerical batch ended before its retained cutoff; the new bounded audit has its own explicit authorization, freeze and deadline. All negative outcomes, platform-enumeration errors, interruptions and amendments are disclosed. Raw/state/full logits/private executables remain in local hash-addressed archives; weights and runtime DLLs are external hash-bound dependencies. Mid-trajectory crossed-state implementation, opaque sampler-byte certification, unique kernel causality, functional accuracy and board energy are not claimed.

Keep this PR **Draft and unmerged**.
